ig_caption:
Wed, Nov 11: 1,602 deer reported statewide (1,212 antlered, 390 antlerless). Season total: 96,993.

Wednesday's new reports were 76% antlered, down from 80% the day before. Tuscola ran the most antlerless of any county with 25 or more new reports (42% of 36), while Washtenaw and Mecosta were both 91% antlered.
